scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique; if ($p) { $p | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('Proceso ' + $_ + ' terminado') } } else { Write-Host 'Puerto 4001 libre' }"
